tasks.title: Stand up the Docker Compose stack with PostgreSQL 18
tasks.dod: docker compose up starts the API and PostgreSQL 18 on a private network with a named volume, only the API port is published, and docker compose down -v leaves nothing behind.

tasks.title: Build the Testcontainers PostgreSQL 18 fixture for the integration suite
tasks.dod: An xUnit collection fixture starts PostgreSQL 18 in Testcontainers, gives each test a clean database, and SmokeTests.cs is deleted from the integration project.

tasks.title: Add the CI job that builds the solution and runs every test
tasks.dod: A CI workflow runs ./build.sh build then ./build.sh test on push and pull request with Docker available, and a deliberately failing test turns the job red.

tasks.title: Decide by ADR what the module names in a *.NotFound error code
tasks.dod: A project-wide ADR states whether the module names the aggregate not found or the aggregate being operated on, both core-ledger and csv-import contracts match it, and api-sync-report.md no longer parks the convention.

tasks.title: Add the domain primitives: Money, DateRange, CategoryKind, IClock and the domain error
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover Money arithmetic and DateRange boundary days, Domain still references nothing, and SmokeTests.cs is deleted from FinNavis.Domain.UnitTests.

tasks.title: Add the Account entity and IAccountRepository
tasks.dod: Unit tests show a rename keeps the same identity (AC-08) and a blank or over-100-character name is refused; the entity carries no balance field.

tasks.title: Add the Category and CategoryGroup entities with the same-side invariant
tasks.dod: Unit tests show placing a category into a group on the other side is refused (AC-30), moving or renaming keeps identity (AC-13, AC-28, AC-34), clearing the link leaves the category intact (AC-29), and nothing creates a Default group.

tasks.title: Add the Transaction entity and ITransactionRepository
tasks.dod: Unit tests show an amount of zero or below is refused (AC-02), a note over 500 characters is refused, an amount edit applies in place with no reversing entry (AC-21), and naming a second account is refused (AC-24).

tasks.title: Add the Transfer entity and ITransferRepository
tasks.dod: Unit tests show a same-account transfer is refused (AC-05) and a non-positive amount is refused; the entity exposes no category (AC-23) and carries both sides in one object so a half-applied transfer is unrepresentable (AC-06).

tasks.title: Declare IUnitOfWork and the ILedgerQueries read port with its result records
tasks.dod: Both ports are declared in Application/Abstractions with plain read-row results, nothing in Application references EF Core or HTTP, and the architecture tests stay green.

tasks.title: Add FinNavisDbContext and the five entity configurations
tasks.dod: Every column type, bound, index and unique constraint matches data-model.md row by row, CategoryKind uses HasConversion<string>(), and no CHECK constraint, trigger, business default or FK cascade exists.

tasks.title: Generate the EF Core migration and diff it against the staged SQL spec
tasks.dod: ./build.sh migrate CoreLedgerInitial produces a migration whose script matches the five staged .up.sql pairs; it applies and reverts cleanly against PostgreSQL 18 in Testcontainers, and the fixture now applies migrations.

tasks.title: Add the five EF Core repository adapters and the unit of work
tasks.dod: Every repository port round-trips an entity through PostgreSQL in Testcontainers, the three name-scoped existence checks hit their unique index, a failed commit rolls back the whole unit of work, and the architecture tests stay green.

tasks.title: Implement the balance query and the two delete existence checks
tasks.dod: Integration tests show a balance equals the sum of its movements (AC-14) and a transfer leaves the total unchanged (AC-15), and the two existence checks answer correctly for accounts (AC-09) and categories (AC-12) using their indexes.

tasks.title: Implement the history page: UNION ALL with a keyset cursor
tasks.dod: Integration tests show filtered movements marked as transaction or transfer with notes (AC-16), an empty period returning an empty page not a failure (AC-17), and paging forward then back over seeded data returning every row exactly once with an opaque cursor and limit 1-200 default 50.

tasks.title: Implement the period breakdown aggregate query
tasks.dod: One aggregate query returns totals per category and per group with sides kept apart (AC-18), its generated SQL names no transfers table (AC-20), group totals plus the ungrouped total equal the period total (AC-19), and it uses both expected indexes.

tasks.title: Register every adapter and use case in the composition root
tasks.dod: A resolution test proves every port declared in Domain/Abstractions and Application/Abstractions resolves from the container, Presentation registers no Infrastructure type one by one, and no connection string is in a committed file.

tasks.title: Write the four account use cases
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover create reading back at zero (AC-07), rename keeping every movement (AC-08), delete refused with recorded history (AC-09) and allowed without (AC-10), duplicate names refused (AC-35), and an unknown id reported as unknown (AC-25).

tasks.title: Write the four category-group use cases
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover create on a named side holding no categories (AC-26), list with name and side (AC-27), rename leaving category figures unchanged (AC-28), delete clearing links and removing the group in one unit of work with no category deleted (AC-29), and a duplicate name refused per side (AC-31).

tasks.title: Write the five category use cases
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover create with and without a group (AC-11), delete refused with history (AC-12), move between groups keeping the figure (AC-13), the other-side refusal (AC-30), the unknown-group refusal creating nothing (AC-32), list all and narrowed (AC-33), rename keeping the closed-period figure (AC-34), and a duplicate name refused per side (AC-36).

tasks.title: Write the three transaction use cases
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover recording with the note kept (AC-01), the unknown-category refusal creating nothing (AC-03), an in-place amount edit (AC-21), a hard delete (AC-22), the kind-change refusal (AC-24), and an unknown id reported as unknown (AC-25); external_ref stays null.

tasks.title: Write the three transfer use cases
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover source falling and destination rising with the total unchanged (AC-04), the same-account refusal (AC-05), a failed commit changing neither account (AC-06), the category refusal on edit (AC-23), and unknown ids reported as unknown (AC-25).

tasks.title: Write the history and breakdown use cases
tasks.dod: Unit tests cover filtered history with marked rows (AC-16), an empty period returning an empty page not a failure (AC-17), group and category totals with sides apart (AC-18), group totals plus the Default group equalling the period total (AC-19), and no transfer counted (AC-20); the Default group bucket is assembled, never stored.

tasks.title: Build the error registry and route every failure through the flat envelope
tasks.dod: All 27 codes in the registry match contracts/openapi.yaml string for string and a test fails if either side drifts; a routing 404 and a model-binding failure both return the flat envelope rather than application/problem+json, with snake_case keys everywhere including inside details.

tasks.title: Add the four account endpoints
tasks.dod: The four endpoints match the contract field for field and return the PRD outcomes for AC-07, AC-08, AC-09, AC-10 and AC-35; every 4xx carries the flat envelope and no response record is shared with another operation folder.

tasks.title: Add the four category-group endpoints
tasks.dod: The four endpoints match the contract field for field and return the PRD outcomes for AC-26, AC-27, AC-28, AC-29 and AC-31, with deleteCategoryGroup returning 204 and no body; every 4xx carries the flat envelope.

tasks.title: Add the five category endpoints
tasks.dod: The five endpoints match the contract field for field and return the PRD outcomes for AC-11, AC-12, AC-30, AC-32, AC-33, AC-34 and AC-36; every 4xx carries the flat envelope and setCategoryGroup tells its two 404 refusals apart.

tasks.title: Add the three transaction endpoints
tasks.dod: The three endpoints match the contract field for field and return the PRD outcomes for AC-01, AC-02, AC-03, AC-21, AC-22 and AC-24; money crosses the wire as a string, external_ref is not surfaced, and every 4xx carries the flat envelope.

tasks.title: Add the three transfer endpoints
tasks.dod: The three endpoints match the contract field for field, carry no category field anywhere, and return the PRD outcomes for AC-04, AC-05, AC-06 and AC-23; every 4xx carries the flat envelope.

tasks.title: Add the history and breakdown endpoints
tasks.dod: Both endpoints match the contract field for field including the cursor page wrapper with prev_cursor, and return the PRD outcomes for AC-16, AC-17, AC-18, AC-19 and AC-20; an empty period is a 200 and every 4xx carries the flat envelope.

tasks.title: Prove QG-1: the balance invariant over 1 000 randomised operation sequences
tasks.dod: A property-based test generates at least 1 000 randomised sequences of recordings, edits and deletions against PostgreSQL 18 in Testcontainers and reports 0 balance discrepancies, with the total across accounts unchanged by any transfer and a failing seed printed.

tasks.title: Prove QG-2: seed 20 000 movements, time the three budgets, assert the index
tasks.dod: A repeatable seeder builds ~20 000 movements and the three named latency tests pass at p95 <= 300 ms, <= 500 ms and <= 400 ms, the CI smoke test measures >= 10 requests/s, and the EXPLAIN assertion fails if the breakdown index is dropped.

tasks.title: Prove QG-3: report stability when categories and groups are reshaped
tasks.dod: The three sad.md §10 QG-3 tests pass against seeded data in Testcontainers, plus the group-rename, group-removal and category-rename cases, and a direct query proves no Default row exists in category_groups.

tasks.title: Diff the served OpenAPI document against the contract and close the deferrals
tasks.dod: The document served at /openapi/v1.json and contracts/openapi.yaml agree on all 21 operations and 27 error codes, api-sync-report.md is re-run with drift points 2 and 6 no longer deferred, and CLAUDE.md "Not set up yet" lists only what is still missing.
